mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, compressing the required return on capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of historical instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 330 (annual inflation > 3.5%) triggers equity market risk aversion due to real earnings erosion, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors demand higher risk premiums.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 330 and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 24000) and housing market strength (HOUST > 1400) signal robust consumer spending and business investment, driving positive equity returns through earnings acceleration and reduced recession risk over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 24000 and HOUST > 1400 but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 158000) indicates strong employment growth and wage momentum, supporting consumer spending and corporate profit growth that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 158000 but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5) indicates strong manufacturing output, which correlates with rising corporate capital expenditures and earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.5 and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of historical cases.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 750000) reflects strong housing sector activity, boosting consumer confidence and construction-related corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 750000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS > 158000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0) signal a tight labor market that sustains wage growth and consumer spending, generating positive equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 158000 and UNRATE < 4.0 but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening with low inflation (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL < 335) signals controlled policy response to inflation, reducing recession risk and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL < 335
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL < 335 but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
